as_told.title: Hoagland's Face on Mars and Cydonia pyramids

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Cydonia, a region on the surface of Mars, contains several pyramids that are basically the remains of a city. In another episode he credits the idea to a writer, Richard Hoagland, and his book Dark Mission, and links it to the "Face on Mars," a formation there said to look like a human face. If true, it would mean someone once built on Mars.
